topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: Well, now, this ain’t something you hear every day. A hidden room, eh? Must be the work of some crafty builder, hiding his secrets away. I reckon it could be a cold cell for storin’ foods, or maybe a place where the old folk used to hide from bandits. Mind you, it’s a mite risky, uncovering such things. You never know what kind of spirits or curses might be laid there. Best to pray to Saint Cuthbert for guidance and protection. And maybe light a candle or two. A man’s home is his castle, but some castles have their dark corners. Must be quite a find, though, to think about all that history buried in your own walls.
